partner.title: Partner registration link
partner.hint: Each bot has its own link. The registration button in this bot’s Mini App uses it.
partner.linkHint: https only. {click_id} becomes the user’s personal click code, {bot_id} the bot ID, {partner_id} the partner ID. An empty field turns registration off.
partner.partnerIdHint: Saved with every click and used for {partner_id}.
partner.saved: Link saved. New clicks use it right away; earlier clicks and user bindings are kept.
partner.cleared: Link removed. The Mini App will say that registration is not set up yet.

problem.format: This does not look like an https link.
problem.no_click_id: The link has no {click_id}: the partner cannot report which user registered.
problem.partner_id_empty: The link contains {partner_id}, but the partner ID is empty.
problem.private_host: The address points to a private network; it is not checked and will not work for users.

partner.howItWorks: How it works: the user taps the registration button, the server creates a personal click_id and stores it with the Telegram ID, bot ID and partner ID, then opens your link. Once postback is connected, the partner sends that click_id back and the registration is confirmed automatically.

telegram.title: Menu button and welcome
telegram.hint: Applied in Telegram as soon as you save. A step counts as done only after Telegram confirms it.
telegram.menuButtonHint: The button next to the message field opens the Mini App. Up to 32 characters.
telegram.welcomeNote: The bot replies in the language the user picked in the Mini App, otherwise in the bot’s default language. The message always has a button that opens the app.
telegram.partial: Saved, but Telegram rejected some steps. Reasons are below.

markets.simNote: No quote source is connected, so both modes run in SIMULATION MODE: synthetic prices marked DEMO / SIMULATED. A real source can be added later without changing the screens.
markets.forexHint: The Forex simulation pauses on weekends, like the real market.
markets.otcHint: A separate OTC simulation running around the clock. Never presented as broker quotes.
markets.saved: Saved. The Mini App applies the settings the next time it opens.

delete.title: Delete bot
delete.text: Removes this bot’s settings, users, demo signal history, clicks and postback events. Other bots are untouched. The webhook and menu button are removed in Telegram. The deletion stays in the audit log. This cannot be undone; to pause a bot, use Disable.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Languages and Mini App, Forex and OTC — separately for each bot.
settings.systemHint: Set by environment variables in Render. Secrets are never shown here.

bot.welcome: Welcome to {name}! Open the app to see market analytics and take the course.
bot.disabled: This bot is temporarily unavailable. Your data is safe — check back later.

market.simulatedText: Prices, candles and signals are synthetic — a training simulation, not market quotes or trading advice.
market.forexClosed: Forex is closed; the Forex simulation is paused until it opens ({time}). OTC mode is available.

demo.disclaimer: Training demo mode. Simulation results say nothing about future results in a real market. Not investment advice.

basis.rsi_oversold: RSI {rsi}: the simulated price is oversold (below 30), so the training signal is up.
basis.rsi_overbought: RSI {rsi}: the simulated price is overbought (above 70), so the training signal is down.
basis.above_average: RSI {rsi} is neutral; price is above its 20-candle average — training signal up.
basis.below_average: RSI {rsi} is neutral; price is below its 20-candle average — training signal down.

onb.registerText: Register with the broker using the link below. Then come back and enter your Trader ID so we can link the account to your Telegram.
onb.registerAgainText: You have already opened the registration page. If the account is created, tap “I have registered”. If not, open the link again.
onb.point1: Registration takes a couple of minutes
onb.point2: The Academy and demo mode are open without registration or a deposit
onb.point3: Progress is saved in your profile, on any device
onb.linkFallback: Page did not open? Tap here
onb.traderText: Your Trader ID is your account number at the broker. Find it in your account area, usually in the profile or the top right corner.
onb.traderHint: The format is checked right away. Registration is confirmed by the partner program; until then the status is “Awaiting verification”.
onb.waitText: Your Trader ID is saved. All sections open once the partner program confirms the registration. No need to register again.
onb.browse: Look at the Academy and demo first
onb.browseNote: You can continue registration any time from your profile.
onb.depositAfterVerify: Deposit status appears after the Trader ID is confirmed. It comes only from the partner program’s data.
onb.depositNoSource: Deposit data is not connected yet. We never show a status the source has not confirmed.
